classification_policy.current_source_backed: The exact surface form already exists in data/common-words.json.
classification_policy.source_ranked_gap: The exact surface form exists in the original Parole source but is outside the current common vocabulary range.
classification_policy.curated_unranked: No exact Parole surface-form match exists; keep the target curriculum-owned and do not fabricate frequency metadata.

recommendation.rationale: Choose the standard 50-entry endpoint up to source position 2000 with the highest cumulative exact A1.2 target yield per added Parole form. This keeps the next source-backed expansion small and avoids inflating the common vocabulary merely to absorb low-frequency topic forms.
